question: What most likely explains the spike in refund requests last week?

evidence.text: The primary shipping carrier reported regional delivery delays starting Monday.
Refund requests citing 'item never arrived' rose 3x starting Wednesday.
Overall order volume was flat week over week.
A billing-page redesign shipped on Tuesday of the same week.

units.text: Delivery delays began Monday and 'never arrived' refunds rose starting Wednesday.
Order volume itself did not change.
The refund spike tracks the delivery delay rather than a change in ordering behavior.
The billing redesign is causing the refund spike.
It is unknown whether some fraction of the 'never arrived' refunds are unrelated to the carrier delay.
